documents.title: Notice Of Annual General Meeting Along With Annual Report For FY 2025-26

analysis.summary: Uniparts India Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year, accompanied by a net cash position of approximately INR190 crores. Management highlighted that construction equipment demand remains robust while large agricultural equipment is at its cyclical bottom, with recovery expected in calendar year 2027. The company continues to evaluate inorganic acquisition targets in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications while experiencing strong operational performance and supply chain resilience. Uniparts India Ltd reported its financial results for Q1 FY27, highlighting revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%. Management noted that performance aligned with quarterly guidance and surpassed annual expectations, supported by strong execution despite input cost pressures from the West Asia situation.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the full year FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Q1 FY27 performance was in line with quarterly guidance but better than annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The small agriculture segment in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment conditions remain subdued, with leading OEMs indicating that calendar year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry. Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: India's small agricultural equipment segment continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects large ag industry to face a mid-teens decline in 2026 before growth resumes in FY28.
demand_outlook.quote: Large ag in '26 is facing its trough. We expect mid-teens decline in the large ag industry this year. And again, the growth will come in FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum from second half of CY2025 continued into Q1 FY27 with healthy customer schedules.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum that started in the second half of CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agriculture in India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidies and higher horsepower adoption.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programmes and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket represented approximately 12 percent of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Aftermarket represents approximately 12% of revenues in Q1 FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: In North America, construction equipment demand is expected to gradually strengthen through the year with the second half being better than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: The small agriculture market in North America is on the path of recovery.

demand_outlook.claim: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, the small agriculture market is showing early signs of stabilization after a prolonged period of softening.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs affirmed that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough for large agricultural machinery.
demand_outlook.quote: Let me talk about the large agricultural machinery, continues to work through the current down cycle with leading OEMs affirming that quarter 4 of '26 represents a cyclical trough.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: We also have the aftermarket sector, and the aftermarket continues to be a stable contributor for Uniparts across North America and Europe.

capex_expansion.claim: The restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, aligned with capacity enhancement and customer-led growth initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure remains unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stands at INR 12 crores for the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering a 55% growth year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that cycle EBITDA margins through peak to trough are about 20%.
margins_costs.quote: So Mr. Jain, when we talk about 20% margins, we are talking about 20% margins over a cycle which is peak to trough. We maintain that.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin was 66.6 percent of revenue from operations in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (As % of Revenue from Ops) 66.6%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was 25.3 percent.
Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% in quarter 4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month business wins exceeded INR 225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: New business awards were over INR 225 crores in annualized potential over the last 12 months.
orders_capacity.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: A special dividend of INR 101 crore was declared in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to be net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as on March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR 170 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused some demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices caused moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Towards the end of quarter 3, one of the facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incident in the finishing shop.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the fabrication vertical will become a meaningful vertical within the specified timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects normal operations to return on schedule regarding the Ludhiana facility rebuilding effort.
management_commitments.quote: We expect normal operations to return on schedule.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that as volumes build through FY27, the company expects to operate comfortably above the 20% EBITDA level.
management_commitments.quote: And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

management_commitments.claim: Management endeavors to continue maintaining the improved working capital and inventory levels.
management_commitments.quote: The endeavour is to continue maintaining these levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
